sources.title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
sources.snippet: Video world models create new observations as users move the camera, but maintaining a coherent world requires remembering scenes beyond the recent context and recovering their appearance and structure when revisited. WorldCrafter addresses this challenge with a camera-queryable, implicit 3D-aware memory.

sources.title: GitHub - TencentARC/WorldCrafter: [Arxiv 2026] WorldCrafter: Consistent ...
sources.snippet: WorldCrafter enables consistent, camera-controlled scene exploration from an image or text prompt. Its camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory preserves scene information across viewpoints and over long horizons. We provide WorldCrafter-Base and WorldCrafter-Fast, a distilled model for faster inference.
